name: HAMMER STRENGTH ISO-LATERAL LEG CURL_Both Leg

current.instructions:
1. Lie face down on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, placing your ankles under the leg pads and holding the handles on the sides of the machine for stability. Start with both legs fully extended.
2. Curl both legs by bending your knees and pulling your ankles towards your glutes.
3. Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Keep your hips pressed against the bench throughout the exercise.
2. Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.

name: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl Both Arm

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl machine with your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing up, and position your elbows on the pads.
2. Curl both handles by bending your elbows, bringing your hands towards your shoulders.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position with control.
4.  Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Exhale as you curl the handles up and inhale as you lower them back down.
2. Maintain a neutral wrist position to prevent strain.
3. Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement.

name: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl Single Arm

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl machine with your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing up, and position your elbows on the pads.
2. Curl the right handle by bending your elbow, bringing your hand towards your shoulder while keeping the other arm extended.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement and slowly lower the handle back to the starting position with control.
4.  Repeat with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions and then switch to your left arm and repeat.
current.tips:
1. Exhale as you curl the handle up and inhale as you lower it back down.
2. Maintain a neutral wrist position to prevent strain.
3. Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement.

name: HAMMER STRENGTH MTS ISO-LATERAL DECLINE PRESS Single Arm

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Decline Press, back pressed against the backrest and feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing down.
2. Press the right handle forward by extending your arm, keeping the other arm stationary. 
3. Squeeze your chest muscles at the bottom of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat with the same arm for the desired number of repetitions and then switch to your left arm and repeat.
current.tips:
1. Exhale as you press the handle and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
2. Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
3. Focus on engaging your chest muscles throughout the movement.

name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Alternate Arms

current.instructions:
1. Sit on the Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row machine with your feet flat on the floor and your chest pressed against the chest pad. Grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing forward.
2. Pull one handle towards your torso by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade back, while keeping the other arm extended.
3. Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement and slowly return the handle to the starting position with control.
4. Repeat with the other arm, alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed against the pad and your back straight throughout the exercise.
2. Focus on engaging your back muscles throughout the movement.
3. Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
